title: drive-coding CLI specs override
description: Per-CLI overrides for bin/args/env/displayName/logo. Loaded by loadCliSpecsOverride (packages/provider/src/config/cli-config-file.ts). Keys are CLI kinds (built-in or new); values are partial CliSpec overrides merged on top of CLI_SPECS from @drive-coding/core.

$schema.description: Pointer to this JSON Schema (ignored by the runtime parser).

cliSpecOverride.description: Partial CliSpec — every field is optional; unset fields fall back to the built-in CLI_SPECS.

bin.description: Executable path or PATH-resolvable name. Absolute paths are recognized without a symlink (v0.28.0+).

args.description: Fixed arguments always passed to the CLI.

supportsModelFlag.description: Whether the CLI accepts `--model <id>` on the command line. opencode/omp = false (model override happens via ACP session/new).

unsetEnv.description: Environment variables to delete from the child process before spawn (e.g. OneCLI proxy/CA vars).

setEnv.description: Environment variables to set/override on the child process before spawn. On collision with unsetEnv, setEnv wins.

displayName.description: Display name shown in the FE CLI dropdown. Absent → the CLI kind identifier is used.

logo.description: Local file path or HTTPS URL to a logo image. Plain HTTP URLs are blocked by the browser (mixed-content). Absent → a deterministic monogram is shown.
